findings.issue: Dangling credential clause: the reframe appends 'as a registered New Jersey Home Improvement Contractor' directly after the trailing local-specifics list ('...row houses, and Ironbound flat-roof commercial blocks'), so the credential reads as a modifier of the building types ('blocks as a registered HIC') rather than of the company. The gold avoids this because it has no trailing local-specifics clause before the credential. Unlike East Orange/Orange, Newark keeps a building-type tail after 'originate', which the credential now dangles off of.
findings.suggestedFix: **Newark Quality Roofing is a roofing contractor installing and repairing roof flashing across Newark, New Jersey, and Essex County**, sealing the chimneys, sidewalls, valleys, skylights, and penetrations where most roof leaks originate on the city's brownstones, row houses, and Ironbound flat-roof commercial blocks. Newark Quality Roofing works as a registered New Jersey Home Improvement Contractor.
